question: Does the OBIS CC-BY-NC label alone establish permission to redistribute FishNet2-derived records in Bangwit, and can a separately published KAUM dataset provide a direct, independently licensed record crosswalk?

verificationAttempts.result: Publicly indexed portal terms reviewed; full portal UI is JavaScript-rendered.
Web retrieval returned 404; workspace HEAD request timed out; no archive retained.
No exact indexed record match found; GBIF API request timed out/inaccessible in this review. This is an access limitation, not a zero-occurrence result.

method.limitations: This is a source-rights and access review, not legal advice, a final interpretation of license precedence, or a specimen/locality determination. No one was contacted and no portal agreement was accepted.

fishNet2ObisDataset.providerDescription: OBIS describes the dataset as compiled from the FishNet2 service and limited to marine specimens.

fishNet2PortalTerms.reportedAudience: Non-profit educational use and personal research by students and scholars.
fishNet2PortalTerms.redistributionCondition: The portal terms state that data may not be repackaged, resold, or redistributed without express written consent from the appropriate curatorial authority at each contributing institution.
fishNet2PortalTerms.provenanceCondition: Acknowledge the original data providers and FishNet2 in presentations/publications; the portal advises direct specimen/record verification because outdated names and locality errors can occur.

findings.unresolvedApplicability: The OBIS dataset page displays CC-BY-NC 4.0 while the FishNet2 portal states an additional written-consent condition for repackaging/redistribution. Whether and how the portal terms apply to the OBIS-mirrored records and each contributing collection was not resolved. Do not assume the broader CC license is sufficient for app redistribution.

alternateKaumDataset.title: Fish collection of the Kagoshima University Museum
alternateKaumDataset.publisher: National Museum of Nature and Science, Japan

findings.crosswalkState: No record-specific connection between FishNet2 occurrence/catalog IDs 57150–57163 and a row in the separate KAUM/NMNS dataset was verified. Its CC-BY license cannot be applied to the FishNet2 rows without a valid source-record match.

nextActions: Hold the 14 FishNet2 candidates from app/public reuse until written terms from the contributing curators clarify redistribution permission for the OBIS mirror.

Retry the official KAUM archive or query its publisher-hosted search when reachable, and require exact institution/catalog/occurrence identity before considering any KAUM row as an independent source.
If an exact KAUM source record is found, preserve its own citation, license, locality, date and coordinates; do not transfer those fields to a FishNet2 row without a documented match.
